# Bid the walls, the chip-out, and the finish.

> Price a pool replaster from floor-plus-wall surface, finish (white plaster, quartz, pebble, glass), chip-out, spa, steps, waterline tile, and coping — not the homeowner's length × width. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper water-surface quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
